answer: Make scale the trap: a cipher census, a reef of guarantors, and basalt custody. Each identity publishes a cipher commitment naming funder and endorsers, then locks its stake in basalt custody. Standing comes only from the reef: peers holding a bond fragment who can open the cipher commitment and check names. When two commitments point at one funding cluster, the reef merges them into one standing, caps it at one share, and burns each bond by the merged set size. One participant stakes once; N copies stake N times, gain nothing extra, and forfeit an amount growing with the square of their size.
